title: Boundary-mass bound for the slice of a represented boundary
statement: Assume (SL), the frozen statement of dimred_mbl_slice_mass_bounds. It appears verbatim as the first hypothesis of this Lean statement and is identical to the first hypothesis of the selected parent dmcbr_sl_slice_and_boundary_mass_bound. (SL) says: for all P, k ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), measures μ, μ' on ℝ^P finite on compact subsets of U, fields ξ of (k+1)-vectors and ξ' of k-vectors, a.e. strongly measurable for μ resp. μ', such that for μ-a.e. x, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for every covector α, and for μ'-a.e. x, |ξ'(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for every covector α (|α| the Euclidean covector norm), T(ω) = ∫ξ(ω)dμ for all ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(U) and ∂T(η) = ∫ξ'(η)dμ' for all η ∈ 𝒟^k(U), and every L-Lipschitz f : ℝ^P → ℝ (L ∈ ℝ≥0), there are A_t ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), B_t ∈ 𝒟_k(U) (t ∈ ℝ) with A_t(ω) = ∫_{f<t} ξ(ω)dμ, B_t(η) = ∫_{f<t} ξ'(η)dμ', ∂A_t(η) = B_t(η) whenever tsupport η ∩ {f = t} = ∅, M_W(∂A_t − B_t) ≤ L·liminf_{h→0+} h⁻¹μ(W ∩ {t − h < f < t}) for every open W and t, and ∫_{(a,b)} M_W(∂A_t − B_t) dt ≤ L·μ(W ∩ {a < f < b}) for every open W and a, b ∈ ℝ. Let P, m ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, T ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U), μ a measure on ℝ^P with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_m(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P m) a.e. strongly measurable for μ such that for μ-a.e. x, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for every m-covector α. Assume ∂T(η) = ∫ ξ(x)(η(x)) dμ(x) for every η ∈ 𝒟^m(U). Let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be L-Lipschitz (L ∈ ℝ≥0), t ∈ ℝ, W ⊆ ℝ^P open, and B ∈ 𝒟_m(U) with B(η) = ∫_{f<t} ξ(x)(η(x)) dμ(x) for every η ∈ 𝒟^m(U). Then boundaryMassOn(B, W) ≤ L·liminf_{h→0+} h⁻¹μ(W ∩ {t − h < f < t}). Here boundaryMassOn(B, W) = 0 if m = 0 and = M_W(∂B) if m ≥ 1, h⁻¹ stands for ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹, the liminf is along 𝓝[>]0, and all quantities lie in [0, ∞].
